identification: Twelve Folio Society books in slipcases, read from the spines: A is for Ox (Lyn Davies), The Rise and Fall of the British Empire (Lawrence James), Five Days in London May 1940 (John Lukacs), Empires of the Word (Nicholas Ostler), The English Language (Robert Burchfield), The Stones of Venice (John Ruskin), The Folio Poets Kipling, Venice (Jan Morris), The Earth: An Intimate History (Richard Fortey), Dickens' London, Impossible Journeys (Mathew Lyons), Seeds of Change (Henry Hobhouse). Standard Folio Society editions (mostly 1990s-2010s), not limited editions.

5 cased Folio items (Shirer Rise and Fall of the Third Reich 4 vols, Gilbert Holocaust 3 vols, Watson Ideas 2 vols, Levi, Taylor). About GBP26 a case, but several are multi-volume sets, which sell better than the single volumes here. Rate 1 GBP = 2.0 AUD.

28 slipcases of Folio Society incl. Wilde Writings 3 vols, Donne, Norwich History of Venice. About GBP4 (A$8) a slipcase: the low end. Rate 1 GBP = 2.0 AUD.
